quotes.text: The source materials are instructional standardized-patient and simulation cases and do not contain identifiable patient information.
The constructed MedSP1000 dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/byrLLCC/MedSP1000 under a CC BY-NC-SA licence

parsed.rationale: The record source is stated as instructional teaching cases without identifiable patient data (not labelled synthetic with a generator, and not inferred). Dataset terms (CC BY-NC-SA) are stated separately from the code licence. No IRB determination, DUA or de-identification method is given. The README states MIT for code versus CC BY-SA in the paper, noted.
